problem: Predict deformable geometry from observed positions and tool poses with unknown material and environmental interactions; evaluate held-out interaction families before and after adaptation.
primary_inputs: tool poses and observed tool trajectory
primary_scope: Quasistatic position-controlled interactions; dynamic release/impact claims require separate validated dynamic ground truth.

baseline_plan.phystwin: Official pinned implementation with native moving controller trajectories; no simulator force labels supplied.
baseline_plan.physgaussian: Assess runnable official MPM implementation and position-control compatibility; any inverse-fitting adaptation labelled explicitly.
baseline_plan.position_conditioned_neural: Learned displacement predictor with the same observed prefix and positional action inputs.
baseline_plan.proposed: Position-query deformation prediction with latent material and explicit environmental interaction hypotheses; predictive uncertainty and limited-observation adaptation.
baseline_plan.fixed_spatial_field: Ablation of the proposed inference retaining nominal environmental fields.

fairness: Report all predeclared test groups including failures
Do not call interpolation among known force cases interaction-type OOD
reference_acceptance_norm: RMS over the 81 query points, separately for every action
reference_maximum_error_role: Report separately; not a certificate for pointwise stresses or tractions
expensive_baseline_selection: First six predeclared indices in each independent test cohort, two per attachment layout, selected before any held-out fitting or scoring; compare all methods on this same 18-object subset.
attachment_model: Normalized Gaussian footprint on each end face, tapered continuously to zero at the face perimeter; unknown layout and total compliance.
physical_change: Replace discontinuous half-face attachment density with a smooth finite footprint. Material law, gravity, parameter draws, action poses, observation interface and numerical acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.
secondary_mpm_field_scope: Development-only exploration; prioritize separately calibrated pre/post-probe uncertainty and the complete primary 18-object physical benchmark within the 24-hour campaign.
transfer_fixed_probe_rationale: A +40 mm y positional probe directly tests the spatial direction opposite the held -40 mm y target. Selected from geometry and the archived development diagnostic before any held-out inference; not described as an exhaustive best-fixed search.
transfer_calibration_scope: Reserve independent calibration objects for interval scaling before and after each acquisition policy; calibration responses never enter test-object fits or probe selection.
